scenario.limitations: Illustrative 6.5% starting borrowing cost, fixed EBITDA and principal. This is not a portfolio PD model.

hypothesis: A policy-rate hold is not a neutral credit event: refinancing spreads and debt maturities can still erode covenant headroom.
alternative: Covenant buffers depend on hedges, amortisation, cash holdings, lender margins and EBITDA sensitivity.
falsifier: Company disclosures show fixed-rate protection, earlier refinancing or offsetting EBITDA improvement.
